title: Factors influencing graduate students’ behavioral intention to use Google Classroom: Case study-mixed methods research
reason: UTAUT2 technology-acceptance study: PLS-SEM on survey responses (habit, facilitating conditions, behavioural intention) plus interviews about Google Classroom. All variables are self-report; no platform-recorded indicator.

extraction.n_quote: the study first analyzed survey data from 23 EFL graduate students implementing partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM).
extraction.outcome_or_construct: behavioural intention to use Google Classroom and UTAUT2 constructs (self-report)
extraction.notes: Habit -> BI beta = .99 is a survey-construct path.
